meta.title: Refactor UNICHARSET script storage to use hash map instead of raw array
meta.body_summary: Replace raw char** array for script storage in UNICHARSET with std::unordered_map and std::vector for O(1) lookup and automatic memory management.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot refactored raw array to unordered_map for O(1) script lookup; maintainers request benchmark comparison before merging, PR still open as draft.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 98 changed lines over 2 files, this is a small refactoring by absolute volume. It fits a targeted performance-oriented data structure change that is not yet merged, as maintainers requested performance comparison before merging.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainers stweil and egorpugin requested a comparison between the new hash map implementation and the old manual approach before merging, and questioned performance for small script counts.
review_details.performance_claim: Script lookup is now O(1) with unordered_map instead of O(n) linear search, improving performance for many scripts.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainers blocking merge pending performance comparison; PR remains as draft.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: C++ STL refactoring with claimed algorithmic improvement requires maintainer-requested benchmark evidence before merge, especially for small script counts where hash overhead may outweigh benefit.

detection_detail.code_reading: stweil and egorpugin reviewed the diff, suggested type improvements (size_t, auto), and requested a manual performance comparison.
detection_detail.code_scanning: Original PR triggered by a GitHub code scanning report about potential use-after-free in UNICHARSET; the refactoring aimed to improve memory safety.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling data provided; maintainers requested manual comparison before merging.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR is still open as draft; no regression has been merged, so no handling occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced raw char** array and manual resizing in UNICHARSET script storage with std::unordered_map for name-to-id and std::vector for id-to-name, eliminating manual memory management and O(n) lookup.
change_trajectory: Refactored to use unordered_map and vector, with O(1) lookup, replacing manual char** array.
Per maintainer review, changed script_table_size type from int with static_cast to size_t.
Changed variable to auto per stweil suggestion.
